Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: Four roles, from a 2022 internship to a production crypto analysis app.

sadaapex.description: Architected a production real-time cryptocurrency technical analysis app for iOS and Android with Flutter, Riverpod, and Clean Architecture. Built a custom Canvas charting engine with pan, zoom, a dynamic crosshair, 80+ indicators, and 90+ drawing tools. Integrated spot and futures feeds over WebSocket from Binance, Bitget, and Bybit, plus liquidation heatmaps, funding-rate scanners, large-trade flow, long/short ratios, and Hyperliquid whale analytics.

yerlem.description: Built and maintained enterprise web and mobile applications for workforce management, fleet monitoring, payments, and live telemetry with React, TypeScript, and Flutter. Map interfaces tracked hundreds of vehicles and people at once. Contributed to nine core products: Ulak, Tahsildar, Acun, Pusula, Iyekut, Kimlik, Fuel, Ilgen, and Pamir.

stechome.description: Built responsive web applications for e-commerce, recruitment, and community platforms with React. Delivered core interface components and functional modules for Berlin Esnaf, Getjob, Buhara Baharat, and Demir Yıldızı.

terra.description: Built interface components for Umay, an institutional student tracking system, and Yolbars, an interactive web app for drawing and managing transport routes on a live map.
